name: Ceramic Bloom Flower Vase
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from premium-quality ceramic with a smooth, glossy finish.
    - Durable, sturdy, and designed for long-lasting use.
    - Features an elegant bloom-shaped vase mouth and decorative rope bow for a charming handcrafted look.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    Available in multiple sizes:
  • Small Size:
    Width: 3.35 in (~8.51 cm)
    Top Width: 3.74 in (~9.5 cm)
    Height: 5.31 in (~13.49 cm)
  • Medium Size:
    Width: 4.33 in (~11 cm)
    Top Width: 4.53 in (~11.51 cm)
    Height: 7.87 in (~20 cm)
  • Large Size:
    Width: 4.13 in (~10.49 cm)
    Top Width: 4.72 in (~11.99 cm)
    Height: 9.65 in (~24.51 cm)

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant colors and sharp image quality.
    - Supports both 1-sided printing and 2-sided printing options.
    - Designs are durable, fade-resistant, and maintain excellent detail over time.

 

  • Care Instructions:
    - Wipe clean with a soft, dry, or slightly damp cloth.
    - Do not use abrasive cleaners or rough scrubbers to avoid scratches.
    - Handle with care to prevent chipping or cracking.
    - Suitable for indoor decorative use.
    - Avoid sudden temperature changes or direct exposure to high heat.
    - Keep away from strong impacts or drops.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Perfect for displaying fresh flowers, dried flowers, or decorative arrangements.
    - Suitable for home décor, office desks, shelves, dining tables, bedrooms, and living rooms.
    - Can also be used as a personalized keepsake or decorative centerpiece.
    - Adds elegance and warmth to any space with its modern yet cozy design.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful and meaningful gift suitable for everyone.
    - Perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, weddings, graduations, Mother’s Day, housewarmings, Christmas, and other special occasions.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3–5 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7–15 working days average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 × Ceramic Bloom Flower Vase

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.5-1 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidlines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
